Species.Description: A shy mythical Pokémon that brings flowers to the places it visits.
A wish Pokémon said to wake when falling stars gather overhead.
A small victory Pokémon whose warmth lifts the spirits of its friends.
A sea-born Pokémon that forms a close bond with almost any creature.
The life Pokémon is said to share vitality with forests and their inhabitants.
An immense dark-winged Pokémon that rests high above the valley.
A white dragon whose flames blaze over the island forge.
A black dragon whose thunder shakes the old railroad tracks.
A swift guardian that races through the mountains with a shining blade.
A steadfast guardian whose presence shields its companions.
A drifting sea Pokémon hatched from a gift of the ocean.
A lightning-fast challenger determined to humble overconfident trainers.
A melody Pokémon whose songs carry across the winter shore.

Abilities.Description: The first party Pokémon that would faint each day recovers to full health instead.
While deployed, new wild Pokémon have a 75% chance to begin asleep.
On rainy days, the farmer gains 150 maximum and current stamina.
Zacian's slicing moves and the farmer's sword attacks deal 40% more damage.
Super-effective attacks deal 40% less damage to party Pokémon.
